question: Pentostatin is an inhibitor of the enzyme adenosine deaminase. How is your mechanism of inhibition?

options.opc: It is an analogous inhibitor of the transition state.
options.opd: It is an irreversible covalent inhibitor.

analysis: Pentostatin inhibits the enzyme adenosine deaminase by forming a covalent bond with the enzyme, leading to irreversible inhibition.
